title: Quietly Chewy Greek Brown Rice Dolmades
description: Buttery and chewy Greek dish featuring brown rice, steamed to perfection in grape leaves, perfect for a light and satisfying meal. This vegetarian-friendly dish is a great option for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Rinse the grape leaves and blanch them in boiling water for 30 seconds to make them pliable.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked brown rice, chopped onion, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the butter and lemon juice to the rice mixture and stir until well combined.
To assemble the dolmades, lay a grape leaf flat on a work surface and place about 1 tablespoon of the rice mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the stem end of the leaf over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a neat package.
Repeat with the remaining grape leaves and rice mixture.
Place the dolmades in a large steamer basket, seam-side down, and steam over boiling water for 20 minutes.
Serve the dolmades warm, garnished with lemon wedges and a sprinkle of salt.
